summary: Operator's site + ResNexus: $60 nightly (GS/military/senior $54), weekly/monthly sold; 90 pull-throughs 75x24 full hookup 50A (stored 41 -> 90), showers/laundry/dump/wifi/store, open all year, ResNexus booking. Price gate fails: no gateway.
